from measure import Impl as M
from slugify import Impl as S
from ranges import Impl as R
m, s, r = M(), S(), R()
assert m.to_cm(1.5, "m") == 150
assert m.to_cm(3, "cm") == 3
assert m.to_cm(20, "mm") == 2
assert m.to_cm(0, "m") == 0

assert s.slugify("***") == "untitled"

assert r.merge([[5,7],[1,3],[2,4]]) == [(1,4),(5,7)]

assert r.merge([[1,1]]) == [(1,1)]
assert r.merge([[1,3],[3,5]]) == [(1,5)]          # closed intervals share endpoint
assert r.merge([(3,5),(1,2)]) == [(1,2),(3,5)]    # merely consecutive -> separate
assert r.merge([[1,10],[2,3],[4,5]]) == [(1,10)]
assert r.merge([[5,1]]) == [(1,5)]                # inverted input normalized
